title: SUPER-NATURALINSTRUCTIONS: Generalization via Declarative Instructions on 1600+ NLP Tasks
benchmark_measurement: Task performance (ability to follow natural language instructions) on NLP tasks within the domain of 'World Religions'. The paper does not measure specific aspects like bias or theological knowledge.
findings: The paper does not report any specific findings related to religion. Performance is aggregated across general task types and not broken down by domain, so the performance on 'World Religions' tasks is not specified.
